items.text: Levi akaba aina abatabani bashatu: Gerishomu, Kohati na Merari.
Batabani ba Kohati ni Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uzieli.
Batabani ba Amuramu ni Aroni, Musa na Miriamu. Batabani ba Aroni ni Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.
Eleazari nazara Finehasi, Finehasi nazara Abishua;
Abishua nazara Buki, Buki nazara Uzi;
Uzi nazara Zerahia, Zerahia nazara Merayoti;
Merayoti nazara Amaria, Amaria nazara Ahitubu;
Ahitubu nazara Zadoki, Zadoki nazara Ahimaazi;
Ahimaazi nazara Azaria, Azaria nazara Yohanani;
Yohanani nazara Azaria, (ayakoraga omwoga gw'obukuhani omuli Rwensinga eyo Solomoni yayombekire Yerusalemu).
Azaria nazara Amaria, Amaria nazara Ahitubu;
Ahitubu nazara Zadoki, Zadoki nazara Shalumu;
Shalumu nazara Hilikia, Hilikia nazara Azaria;
Azaria nazara Seraya, Seraya nazara Yehozadaki;
Yehozadaki yatwarwa endore orwo Omukama yarahwire Nebukadineza akatwara abantu ba Yuda na Yerusalemu omu buzahe.
Batabani ba Levi ni Gerishomu, Kohati na Merari.
Batabani ba Gerishomu ni Libuni na Shimei.
Batabani ba Kohati ni Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uzieli.
Batabani ba Merari ni Mali na Mushi. Aga nigo mahiga g'Abalevita nk'okwo baish'enkurubo balikuhonderana.
Eihiga lya Gerishomu: Gerishomu nazara Libuni, Libuni nazara Yahati, Yahati nazara Zima;
Zima nazara Yoa, Yoa nazara Ido, Ido nazara Zera, Zera nazara Yeatheri.
Baijukuru ba Kohati ishe Aminadabu: Aminadabu nazara Kora, Kora nazara Asiri, Asiri nazara Elikana;
Elikana nazara Abiasafu, Abiasafu nazara Asiri;
Asiri nazara Tahati, Tahati nazara Urieli, Urieli nazara Uzia, Uzia nazara Shauli.
Batabani ba Elikana ni Amasai na Ahimoti.
Ahimoti nazara Elikana, Elikana nazara Zofai, Zofai nazara Nahati;
Nahati nazara Eliabu, Eliabu nazara Yerohamu, Yerohamu nazara Elikana.
Batabani ba Samweli: Omuzigaijo ni Yoeli, omushubiro ni Abiya.
Batabani ba Merari ishe Mahili: Mahili nazara Libuni, Libuni nazara Shimei, Shimei nazara Uza;
Uza nazara Shimea, Shimea nazara Hagia, Hagia nazara Asaya.
Aba nibo bantu abo Daudi y'ahaire omuruka gw'okuhoya omuli Rwensinga y'Omukama orwo Esanduku yabaire yaikairemu.

Bakoraga omuruka gw'okuhoya omu maisho g'Ekiikaro ky'Eihema ly'Omuterano kuhika orwo Solomoni yamazire kwombeka Rwensinga y'Omukama omuli Yerusalemu. Kandi bakoraga omulimo gwabo nk'okwo ezamu zabo zabaire zili.
Aba nibo babaga banyamyoga hamoi na batabani babo: Omu Bakohati omuhoyi yabaga Hemani eya Yoeli, Yoeli eya Samweli,
Samweli eya Elikana, Elikana eya Yerohamu, Yerohamu eya Elieli, Elieli eya Toa;
Toa eya Zufu, Zufu eya Elikana, Elikana eya Mahati, Mahati eya Amasai;
Amasai eya Elikana, Elikana eya Yoeli, Yoeli eya Azaria, Azaria eya Zefania;
Zefania eya Tahati, Tahati eya Asiri, Asiri eya Abiasafu, Abiasafu eya Kora,
Kora eya Izihari, Izihari eya Kohati, Kohati eya Levi, Levi eya Isiraeli.
Murumuna Hemani ni Asafu ayamwemeleraga aha bulyo, niwe asafu eya Berekia, Berekia eya Shimea,
Shimea eya Mikaili, Mikaili eya Baaseya, Baaseya eya Malakiya;
Malakiya eya Etini, Etini eya Zera, Zera eya Adaya,
Adaya eya Etani, Etani eya Zima, Zima eya Shimei;
Shimei eya Yahati, Yahati eya Gerishomu, Gerishomu eya Levi.
Mukono ogwa bumosho hayemelerwagayo barumuna babo batabani ba Merari, abalimu Etani eya Kishi, Kishi eya Abudi, Abudi eya Maluki,
Maluki eya Hashabia, Hashabia eya Amazia, Amazia eya Hilikia;
Hilikia eya Amuzi, Amuzi eya Bani, Bani eya Shemeri;
Shemeri eya Mahili, Mahili eya Mushi, Mushi eya Merari, Merari eya Levi.
Barumuna babo Abalevita nibo baronzirwe kukwata emyoga yona ey'Ekiikaro kya Rwensinga ya Ruhanga.

Aroni na baijukurube abalikumutabukaho batambaga ebitambo aha ealutare y'ebihongo by'okwokibwa n'aha ealutare y'obunuma. Bakoraga na buli mulimo gw'Ahatakatifu muno, n'okugilira AbaIsiraeli enyatano nk'okwo Musa omwiru wa Ruhanga yabaire aragiire obutabuzaho kantu.
Aba nibo batabani ba Aroni: Eleazari nazara Finehasi, Finehasi nazara Abishua,
Abishua nazara Buki, Buki nazara Uzi, Uzi nazara Zerahia;
Zerahia nazara Merayoti, Merayoti nazara Amaria, Amaria nazara Ahitubu;
Ahitubu nazara Zadoki, Zadoki nazara Ahimaazi.
Obu nibwo buturo bwabo kuhonderana n'emikulire yabo omu nsi yabo. Baijukuru ba Aroni ab'amahiga g'Abakohati,
bakabaha Heburoni omu nsi ya Yuda n'amalisizo agagyataineho.
Kyonkai ensi y'ekigo n'ebyaro byakyo bakabiha Kalebu eya Yefune.
Baijukuru ba Aroni bakabaha ebigo by'okuhungiramu, nabyo ni Heburoni, Libuna n'amalisizo gayo, Yatiri, Eshitemoa n'amalisizo gayo;
Hileni n'amalisizo gayo; Debiri n'amalisizo gayo;
Ashani n'amalisizo gayo; na Betishemeshi n'amalisizo gayo.
Kandi omu ruganda rwa Benjamini babahamu Geba n'amalisizo gayo, Alemeti n'amalisizo gayo na Anatoti n'amalisizo gayo. Ebigo byabo byona omu mahiga gabo byabaga 13.
Abakohati abandi bakatelerwa ekura omw'ihiga lyabo, bahabwa ebigo 10 omu nusu y'oruganda rwa Manase.
Abagerishoni kuhonderana n'amahiga gabo bakahabwa ebigo 13 omu ruganda rwa Isakari n'omu rwa Asheri n'omu rwa Nafutali n'omu rwa Manase abaturaga Bashani.
Abamerari kuhonderana n'amahiga gabo bakahabwa ebigo 12 omu ruganda rwa Rubeni, n'omu rwa Gadi, n'omu rwa Zebuluni.
Kityo AbaIsiraeli baha Abalevita ebigo ebyo n'amalisizo gabyo.
Kandi omu ruganda rwa Yuda, n'orwa Simeoni, na Benjamini bakatomeleramu ebigo babibaha nk'okwo byatondwa.
Kandi amahiga agandi ag'Abakohati gagiraga ebigo ebyabo omu ruganda rwa Efuraimu.
Bakahabwa ebigo by'okuhungiramu, nabyo ni Shekemu n'amalisizo gayo omu mabanga ga Efuraimu; Gezeri n'amalisizo gayo;
Yokimeamu n'amalisizo gayo, Betihoroni n'amalisizo gayo;
Aihaloni n'amalisizo gayo, Gatirimoni n'amalisizo gayo.
Omu nusu y'oruganda rwa Manase, amahiga agasigaire ag'Abakohati gakahabwamu Aneri n'amalisizo gayo na Bileamu n'amalisizo gayo.
Omu nusu y'oruganda rwa Manase, Abagerishoni bakahabwa Golani n'amalisizo gayo omuli Bashani na Ashitaloti n'amalisizo gayo.
Omu ruganda rwa Isakari bakahabwa Kadeshi n'amalisizo gayo, Daberati n'amalisizo gayo;
Ramoti n'amalisizo gayo, Anemu n'amalisizo gayo.
Omu ruganda rwa Asheri bakahabwamu Mishali n'amalisizo gayo na Abudoni n'amalisizo gayo;
Hukoki n'amalisizo gayo na Rehobu n'amalisizo gayo.
Omu ruganda rwa Nafutali bakahabwamu Kadeshi eya Galilaya n'amalisizo gayo, Hamoni n'amalisizo gayo na Kiriataimu n'amalisizo gayo.
Abamerari abasigaire omu ruganda rwa Zebuluni bakahabwamu Rimono n'amalisizo gayo, Tabori n'amalisizo gayo;
na buseli bwa Yorudani ahali Yeriko, oburugaizoba bwa Yordani; omu ruganda rwa Rubeni bakahabwamu Bezeri n'amalisizo gayo, eli omw'irungu, Yahiza n'amalisizo gayo;
Kedemoti n'amalisizo gayo na Mefaati n'amalisizo gayo.
Omu ruganda rwa Gadi bakahabwamu Ramoti eya Gileadi n'amalisizo gayo, Mahanaimu n'amalisizo;
Heshiboni n'amalisizo gayo na Yazeri n'amalisizo gayo.
